task.title: Dedupe 12 snake_case duplicate route families per CANONICAL_PATH_NAMING decisions
acceptance: Audit services/control-plane/bff/main.py for duplicate route registrations matching the 12 families listed in v3 audit (personas pools deployments rebalances incidents runtimes skills tools mcp-servers vs mcp/servers mcp-tools vs mcp/tools ranking-formulas vs ranking/formulas strategy actions);For path-parameter duplicates (e.g. /bff/personas/{id} AND /bff/personas/{persona_id} producing same URL pattern) apply CANONICAL_PATH_NAMING.md decision A2: keep snake_case declaration and remove the legacy short-form decorator;For genuine URL duplicates with different path segments (e.g. /bff/mcp-servers/* vs /bff/mcp/servers/* and /bff/ranking-formulas vs /bff/ranking/formulas) keep the form FE currently uses per CANONICAL_PATH_NAMING.md Section 1 and serve HTTP 410 Gone with deprecation header on the alternate form;Each removed/410 route has matching pytest case asserting deprecation behavior;Update CANONICAL_PATH_NAMING.md Section 2 with the dedupe action log entry per family (kept canonical removed alias deprecation header timestamp);Live verification after redeploy: curl each of 12 canonical paths returns 200 (or expected status) and each deprecated alternate returns 410 with X-Deprecated header;Do not mark done if any canonical path 404 or any deprecated path still 200 instead of 410
